title: Shake Shack is Back for the TCS New York City Marathon 2026
body_markdown:
Shake Shack is proud to return as the official burger of the TCS NYC Marathon for a third year in a row in partnership with New York Road Runners (NYRR).


We’re giving runners even more opportunities to get a free ShackBurger* with your race bib by extending the offer for a full week (11/1–11/7). Plus, runners can redeem at any company-owned Shack nationwide. For more details on how to redeem, check the email address you used to register for the race for a note from NYRR, or ask a Team Member at your local Shack.


We’re celebrating race day with a custom photo booth and a limited-edition Shake Shack x TCS NYC Marathon t-shirt giveaway! Catch us at 1700 Broadway on Sunday from 12:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. (featuring a live DJ!), or stop by our original Madison Square Park Shack on Marathon Monday (11/2) from 12:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m.


While your race may end at the finish line, your TCS NYC Marathon experience ends at Shake Shack.


***Terms & Conditions:**


*Offer only valid for qualifying orders placed in-Shack with a team member when unique code is presented and fulfilled during the period of 11/1/2026 through 11/7/2026 ("Promotional Period"). Orders must be placed and fulfilled at participating Shake Shack locations (excluding airports, stadiums, arenas, travel plazas and museums) during the Promotional Period. Offer is not valid for app, web, drive-thru, curbside purchases or for orders made through third party delivery apps. One time use per offer. Must add at least one (1) ShackBurger, Veggie Shack, or lettuce wrapped ShackBurger or Veggie Shack to your bag. Offer excludes double and triple ShackBurgers and any add ons or modifications including gluten free buns, bacon and avocado. Offer excludes the cost of the applicable ShackBurger, gift card purchases and any applicable taxes, delivery fees or other fees. While supplies last. Max savings of up to $7.99. Cannot be combined with any other offers or promotions.*
